 function biteWait(f){const b=boatById(S.aboard),rows=weights(f.cfg,f.spot,f.bottom,f.W,clockNow().h,b),sum=rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+r.w,0);return{rows,sum,ms:(TUNE.w0+Math.random()*TUNE.w1)*1000/cl(sum/14,.35,1.7)*(b&&b.biteK||1)}}
 function fishStep(dt){const f=S.f;if(!f||f.phase==='idle')return;const t=NOW(),b=boatById(S.aboard);if(!b){S.f=null;return}
  if(f.phase==='drop'){const k=WEIGHTS3[f.cfg.weight].sink||3;if(t-f.t0>1100){f.depth=Math.min(f.target,f.depth+k*dt*1.6);if(f.depth>=f.target-.01){f.phase='wait';const w=biteWait(f);f.biteAt=t+w.ms;f.sum=w.sum}}return}
  if(f.phase==='wait'){if(f.cfg.weight==='w0')f.depth=cl(2+Math.abs(b.u)*.04,1,4);if(t>=f.biteAt){const w=biteWait(f);if(w.sum<.05){f.biteAt=t+9000;if(!f.toldNone){f.toldNone=1;toast('אין נשיכות — נסו עומק, פיתיון או נקודה אחרת')}return}
    let r=Math.random()*w.sum,q=w.rows[0].q;for(const x of w.rows){r-=x.w;if(r<=0){q=x.q;break}}const si=pickSize(RODS3[f.cfg.rod].cls,BAITS3[f.cfg.bait].key);f.row=makeRow(q,si,f);f.q=q;f.phase='bite';f.biteT=t;
    toast('נשיכה! F — להכות');try{SaveManager.log('fishing','sea_bite',{id:q.id,size:f.row.size,spot:f.spot&&f.spot.id,depth:Math.round(f.depth)})}catch(e){}}return}
  if(f.phase==='bite'){if(S.auto&&t-f.biteT>500)strike();else if(t-f.biteT>3200){f.phase='wait';f.biteAt=t+biteWait(f).ms;if(!BAITS3[f.cfg.bait].reuse&&Math.random()<.5){useBait(f.cfg.bait);toast('הדג לקח את הפיתיון — שמים פיתיון חדש')}else toast('הדג עזב — ממתינים שוב')}return}
  if(f.phase==='fight'){const rod=RODS3[f.cfg.rod],pow=f.row.weightKg*f.q.pow*.32,W=f.W;if(t>f.runT){const big=Math.random()<.45;f.run=big?(.45+Math.random()*.55)*f.stam:.12*f.stam;f.runT=t+(big?900+Math.random()*1900:700+Math.random()*1300)}
   const ratio=cl(pow*f.run/rod.line,0,2.2),noise=W.wave*.07*Math.sin(t/140)+(W.storm?.08*Math.sin(t/57):0),hold=S.auto?(f.T<.7):(S.hold||Input.down('KeyF'));
   let tt;if(hold){f.line=Math.max(0,f.line-rod.spd*TUNE.reel*(1-Math.min(.88,ratio*.75))*dt);tt=.24+ratio*.62+noise}else{if(f.run>.3)f.line+=ratio*4.2*dt;tt=.1+ratio*.36+noise*.5}
   f.T+=(tt-f.T)*Math.min(1,dt*4.5);f.stam=Math.max(.18,f.stam-dt*(hold?.045:.02)*(f.run>.3?1.6:1));
   if(f.q.id==='FS-SE-05'&&t-f.hookT<4500&&!hold&&Math.random()<.035*dt*30/30)return lose('הלוקוס נכנס לסלעים של השונית וקרע את החוט');
   if(f.T>=1)return lose('החוט נקרע — המתיחה גבוהה מדי');if(f.line>rod.cap)return lose('הסליל התרוקן — הדג לקח את כל החוט');if(Math.random()<(.004+W.wave*.004)*dt*(hold?1:.5))return lose('הקרס השתחרר');
   if(f.line<=1.6){const tool=TOOLS3[f.cfg.tool],ok=b.tools.includes(f.cfg.tool)&&f.row.weightKg<=tool.max;if(!ok&&Math.random()<.55)return lose(f.row.weightKg>15?'בלי גאף הדג הגדול נפל ליד הסירה':'הדג נפל ליד הסירה');f.phase='land';f.landT=t}return}
  if(f.phase==='land'){if(t-f.landT>900){f.phase='hold';f.holdT=t;finishCatch(f)}return}

  if(f.phase==='lost'){if(t-f.lostT>1500)S.f={phase:'idle',cfg:f.cfg}}}

    const deg=mx*180/Math.PI,sdeg=sum*180/Math.PI;worst=Math.max(worst,deg);worstSum=Math.max(worstSum,sdeg);if(deg>90.5||sdeg>90.5||c.legs.length||Math.hypot(c.x-b.be.cx,c.y-b.be.cy)>.5)bad++;rows.push(deg)}}
  return{ok:!bad,cases:rows.length,bad,maxTurnDeg:+worst.toFixed(1),maxSumDeg:+worstSum.toFixed(1)}}

  return OUT[key]={P,n:P.length}}

    P.push({k:'stripe2',col:sc,th:jet?3:1,x:ub?(ub.x0+ub.x1)/2:(xa+L*.45)/2,xa,z:(ub?Math.max(fb,ub.z1):fb)+.06})}    if(U.design===2){P.push({k:'fender',f0:0,f1:1,w:Math.max(4,270/L*1.15),col:lv.stripe,band:1});if(tt)tt.col=lv.stripe;else if(roofed)top.top=lv.stripe;else if(!jet)P.push({k:'tTop',x0:-L*.18,x1:L*.06,w:B*.36,z:fb+2,col:lv.stripe});else for(const p of P)if(p.k==='box'&&p.cushion)p.top=lv.stripe;P.push({k:'flag',x:L*.44,y:0,z:fb+.2,big:1})}}
  return{P,lights,fb}}

 function nameOf(spec){if(!NAMED[spec.type])return null;return NAMES[hash('n|'+(spec.id||spec.type))%NAMES.length]}
 function model(spec){const key=spec.type+'|'+spec.L+'|'+spec.B+'|'+(spec.lvKey||'')+'|'+(spec.cargoLive?1:0)+'|'+(spec.id||'')+'|'+(spec.hatches||0)+'|'+(spec.upKey||'')+'|'+(spec.variant==null?'':spec.variant);let M=MODEL.get(key);if(M)return M;
  const ty=T[spec.type]||T.motor,lv0=spec.lv||ty.lv[hash(spec.id||spec.type)%ty.lv.length],lv=/^(yacht|yachtL|cruiser)$/.test(spec.type)?Object.assign({},lv0,{deck:'#e6e3da'}):lv0,m={type:ty.type,L:spec.L,B:spec.B,shape:ty.shape},b=build(ty.type,spec.L,spec.B,lv,spec);
  {const rk=RAKE[spec.type],mm=spec.L/ty.real[0];if(rk)for(const p of b.P)if(p.k==='box'&&(p.win||p.cabin)&&!p.tp&&!p.ctn){const h=p.z1-p.z0,lx=p.x1-p.x0,ly=p.y1-p.y0,f=rk[0]*h*mm;p.tp=[f>0?Math.min(lx*.32,f):Math.max(-lx*.12,f),Math.min(ly*.18,rk[1]*h*mm),Math.min(lx*.12,rk[2]*h*mm)]}}
  M={ty,lv,m,out:outline(m),P:b.P,lights:b.lights,fb:ty.fb,zTop:Math.max(ty.fb+1,...b.P.map(p=>p.z1||p.z||0),b.lights.mast?b.lights.mast[2]:0)};if(MODEL.size>400)MODEL.clear();MODEL.set(key,M);return M}
  
 

 function drawBox(c,o,p,N,lod){const C=[[p.x0,p.y0],[p.x1,p.y0],[p.x1,p.y1],[p.x0,p.y1]],NR=[[0,-1],[1,0],[0,1],[-1,0]],tp=p.tp,H=p.z1-p.z0;

   if(INS){const hp=Math.max(.01,H*10),d=INS[i],nl=Math.hypot(hp,d)||1;nz=d/nl;if(ny*hp/nl+.6*nz<=.015)continue;k=wallK(nx,ny)*(1-Math.abs(nz))+(nz>0?1.06:.6)*Math.abs(nz)}else{if(ny<=.015)continue;k=wallK(nx,ny)}
   const a=C[i],b=C[(i+1)%4];c.fillStyle=shade(p.col,k,N);c.beginPath();poly(c,Q4(i,0,1,0,1));c.fill();
   if(p.ctn&&lod>1){c.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.22)';c.lineWidth=.5;c.beginPath();const n=Math.max(2,Math.round(Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])/3));for(let q=1;q<n;q++){const u=q/n,q0=E(i,u,0),q1=E(i,u,1);c.moveTo(q0[0],q0[1]);c.lineTo(q1[0],q1[1])}c.stroke()}
   if(p.stripe&&lod>0){const sf=p.sf||[.08,.16];c.fillStyle=shade(p.stripe,k,N);c.beginPath();poly(c,Q4(i,0,1,sf[0],sf[1]));c.fill()}
   if(p.win&&lod>0){const len=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]),fA=p.win.big?.3:.42,fB=p.win.big?.88:.8,lit=N>.35,refl=!lit&&lod>1,ra=(.2+.16*Math.max(0,nz)).toFixed(3);

    if(p.win.band||lod<2||len<p.win.p*1.5){pane(.06,.94,lit?'rgba(255,212,140,.92)':p.win.col);if(lod>1&&!lit&&len>14){c.strokeStyle='rgba(225,232,238,.45)';c.lineWidth=.35;c.beginPath();const nm=Math.max(1,Math.round(len/(p.win.p*1.2||6)));for(let q=1;q<nm;q++){const u=.06+.88*q/nm,q0=E(i,u,fA),q1=E(i,u,fB);c.moveTo(q0[0],q0[1]);c.lineTo(q1[0],q1[1])}c.stroke()}}
    else{const n=Math.max(1,Math.floor(len/p.win.p)),wd=.62/n*(p.win.big?1.35:1);let sd=hash(p.x0+'|'+p.z0+'|'+i);for(let q=0;q<n;q++){const u=(q+.5)/n;sd=Math.imul(sd^(sd>>>13),1274126177)>>>0;
      pane(u-wd/2,u+wd/2,lit?((sd&7)<5?'rgba(255,214,140,.95)':'rgba(70,64,52,.9)'):p.win.col)}}
    if(refl){c.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.14)';c.beginPath();poly(c,[E(i,.08,fB),E(i,.5,fB),E(i,.3,fA)]);c.fill()}}
   if(p.text&&lod>1&&ny>.5&&N<.5){const m=E(i,.5,.2);c.fillStyle='#e0731d';c.font='700 '+Math.max(2.4,(p.z1-p.z0)*1.2).toFixed(1)+'px Segoe UI,Arial';c.textAlign='center';c.fillText(p.text,m[0],m[1])}}

 function drawCyl(c,o,p,N){const b=pj(o,p.x,p.y,p.z0),t=pj(o,p.x,p.y,p.z1),r=p.r;c.fillStyle=shade(p.col,.8,N);c.fillRect(b[0]-r,t[1],2*r,b[1]-t[1]);c.beginPath();c.arc(b[0],b[1],r,0,Math.PI);c.fill();

 function paint(c,spec,x,y,h,t,o){o=o||{};try{
  const M=model(spec),L=spec.L,B=spec.B,fb=M.fb,N=o.night!=null?o.night:nightNow(),z0=zoomNow()*(o.scaleHint||1),lod=o.lod!=null?o.lod:(z0<.32?0:z0<.8?1:2),moving=(o.u||0)>3||o.under;
  const F=frame(x,y,h,t,o.ph!=null?o.ph:(hash(spec.id||'b')%628)/100,o.wave,moving,o.anchor==='deck'?fb:0,o.lift||0),out=M.out.P,lv=M.lv,zT=M.zTop;if(o.dry){F.bob=0;F.roll=0}    
   
  if(!o.thumb&&!o.trail&&spec.id)trailRec(spec,F,o);if(!o.thumb&&(o.u||0)>3)wake(c,F,spec,o.trail?o:Object.assign({},o,{trail:TRL.get(spec.id)&&TRL.get(spec.id).P,cur:true}),lod);
   
  if(!o.noShadow){c.fillStyle='rgba(2,14,28,'+(.24*(1-.45*N)).toFixed(3)+')';c.beginPath();poly(c,out.map(p=>sp(F,p[0],p[1],fb+p[2])));
  for(const p of M.P)if(p.k==='box'&&p.z1>fb+.6){const Q=[];for(const[a,b]of[[p.x0,p.y0],[p.x1,p.y0],[p.x1,p.y1],[p.x0,p.y1]]){Q.push(sp(F,a,b,p.z0),sp(F,a,b,p.z1))}poly(c,hull2d(Q))}c.fill('nonzero')}
   
  if(lod>0&&!o.noRefl&&!o.dry){c.save();c.globalAlpha=(.16+.06*N);c.fillStyle=shade(lv.hull,.8,N);c.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<out.length;i++){const a=out[i],b=out[(i+1)%out.length],nx=-(b[1]-a[1]),ny=(b[0]-a[0]),wy=nx*F.s+ny*F.c;if(wy<=0)continue;
    poly(c,[pj(F,a[0]*.97,a[1]*.92,0),pj(F,b[0]*.97,b[1]*.92,0),pj(F,b[0],b[1],-(fb+b[2])*.75),pj(F,a[0],a[1],-(fb+a[2])*.75)])}c.fill();c.restore()}
  

  const HX=.975,HY=HYT[spec.type]||.84,gF=f=>1-Math.pow(1-f,2.2),
   R=(a,f)=>{if(f<0){const u=-f;return[a[0]*(HX-.06*u),a[1]*(HY-.55*u),fb*f]}const g=gF(f);return[a[0]*(HX+(1-HX)*g),a[1]*(HY+(1-HY)*g),(fb+a[2])*f]},
   RP=(a,f)=>{const r=R(a,f);return pj(F,r[0],r[1],r[2])};
  const sides=[];for(let i=0;i<out.length;i++){const a=out[i],b=out[(i+1)%out.length],lx=b[0]-a[0],ly=b[1]-a[1],ln=Math.hypot(lx,ly)||1,nx=-ly/ln,ny=lx/ln,wx=nx*F.c-ny*F.s,wy=nx*F.s+ny*F.c;if(wy>-.3)sides.push([a,b,wx,wy])}
  const q4=(a,b,f0,f1)=>[RP(a,f0),RP(b,f0),RP(b,f1),RP(a,f1)],
   nrm=(a,b,f0,f1)=>{const A=R(a,f0),Q=R(b,f0),D=R(a,f1),ex=Q[0]-A[0],ey=Q[1]-A[1],dx=D[0]-A[0],dy=D[1]-A[1],dz=(D[2]-A[2])*10;let nx=-ey*dz,ny=ex*dz,nz=ey*dx-ex*dy;const n=Math.hypot(nx,ny,nz)||1;nx/=n;ny/=n;nz/=n;return[nx*F.c-ny*F.s,nx*F.s+ny*F.c,nz]},
   litK=w=>{const hh=Math.hypot(w[0],w[1])||1,az=Math.abs(w[2]);return cl(wallK(w[0]/hh,w[1]/hh)*(1-az)+(w[2]>0?1.06:.56)*az,.5,1.12)};
  const band=(f0,f1,col,k)=>{if(lod===0){c.fillStyle=shade(col,.8*(k||1),N);c.beginPath();for(const[a,b,wx,wy]of sides)if(wy>-.02)poly(c,q4(a,b,f0,f1));c.fill();return}
   for(const[a,b]of sides){const w=nrm(a,b,f0,f1);if(w[1]+.6*w[2]<=-.02)continue;c.fillStyle=shade(col,litK(w)*(k||1),N);c.beginPath();poly(c,q4(a,b,f0,f1));c.fill()}};
  if(lod>0&&!o.noUW&&!o.dry){c.save();c.globalAlpha=.2*(1-.5*N);c.fillStyle=shade(lv.boot||'#7a2a24',.72,N);c.beginPath();for(const[a,b,wx,wy]of sides)if(wy>-.02)poly(c,q4(a,b,-.6,0));c.fill();
   if(SHIPT[spec.type]){const q=pj(F,L*.5*HX,0,-fb*.32);c.beginPath();c.ellipse(q[0],q[1],L*.03,B*.13,F.h,0,TAU);c.fill()}c.restore()}    
  if(o.dry){band(-1,-.5,lv.boot||'#7a2a24',.72);band(-.5,0,lv.boot||'#7a2a24',.88)}band(0,1,lv.hull,.96);band(0,.16,lv.boot||'#7a2a24',1);
  if(lod>0){const s0=GLOSS[spec.type]?.64:.74,s1=GLOSS[spec.type]?.8:.86;band(.155,.2,'#f4f4f0',1);if(lod>1){band(.2,.45,lv.hull,1);band(.45,s0,lv.hull,1);band(s1,1,lv.hull,1)}band(s0,s1,lv.stripe,1)}
  if(lod>0&&!o.dry){c.strokeStyle='rgba(235,248,255,'+(.5-.25*N).toFixed(2)+')';c.lineWidth=Math.max(.6,B*.02);c.beginPath();for(const[a,b,wx,wy]of sides){if(wy<=-.02)continue;const p=RP(a,0),q=RP(b,0);c.moveTo(p[0],p[1]);c.lineTo(q[0],q[1])}c.stroke()}
   
  if(lod>1&&GLOSS[spec.type]){const gl=GLOSS[spec.type];c.lineCap='round';c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+(.34*(1-N)).toFixed(2)+')';c.lineWidth=Math.max(.35,B*.012);c.beginPath();
   for(const[a,b,wx,wy]of sides){if(wy<.12)continue;const p=RP(a,.93),q=RP(b,.93);c.moveTo(p[0],p[1]);c.lineTo(q[0],q[1])}c.stroke();

  if(lod>1&&SHIPT[spec.type]){c.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+(.1+.05*N).toFixed(2)+')';c.lineWidth=.45;c.beginPath();for(const[a,b,wx,wy]of sides){if(wy<.2)continue;const p=RP(a,.42),q=RP(b,.42),p2=RP(a,.62),q2=RP(b,.62);c.moveTo(p[0],p[1]);c.lineTo(q[0],q[1]);c.moveTo(p2[0],p2[1]);c.lineTo(q2[0],q2[1])}c.stroke();

   if(scr>=3.2){c.save();c.transform(-F.s,F.c,0,KZ/10,q[0],q[1]);c.font='700 '+fs.toFixed(2)+'px Segoe UI,Arial';const tw=c.measureText(nm).width||1;if(tw>wT)c.scale(wT/tw,1);

  const deck=out.map(p=>pj(F,p[0],p[1],fb+p[2]));c.fillStyle=shade(lv.hull,1.1,N);c.beginPath();poly(c,deck);c.fill();

  if(lod>1&&(M.lights.teak||spec.type==='row'||spec.type==='fish'||spec.type==='console'||spec.type==='sport')){c.strokeStyle='rgba(80,60,40,.22)';c.lineWidth=.35;c.beginPath();for(let k=-3;k<=3;k++){const a=pj(F,-L*.46,k*B*.12,fb+.03),b=pj(F,M.lights.teak?-L*.33:L*.3,k*B*.12*(M.lights.teak?1:(1-.2*Math.abs(k)/3)),fb+.03);c.moveTo(a[0],a[1]);c.lineTo(b[0],b[1])}c.stroke()}
  if(lod>1&&L>220){c.fillStyle='rgba(30,36,40,.7)';for(let x=-L*.42;x<L*.4;x+=L*.09)for(const s of[-1,1]){const q=pj(F,x,s*B*.44,fb+.05);c.fillRect(q[0]-1.2,q[1]-1,2.4,2)}}
  if(o.moored&&lod>1&&L<260){for(const s of[-1,1])for(const f of[-.18,.12]){if(s*F.c<-.08)continue;const q=pj(F,L*f,s*B*.5,fb*.55);c.fillStyle=shade(s>0?'#1d3a5a':'#2a4a6a',1,N);c.beginPath();c.ellipse(q[0],q[1],Math.max(.7,B*.05),Math.max(1.1,fb*KZ*.32),0,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.3)';c.beginPath();c.arc(q[0]-.3,q[1]-fb*KZ*.15,Math.max(.3,B*.015),0,TAU);c.fill()}}
   
  const items=[];for(const p of M.P){const cx=p.x!=null?p.x:p.x0!=null?(p.x0+p.x1)/2:0,cy=p.y!=null?p.y:p.y0!=null?(p.y0+p.y1)/2:0;items.push([p.sk!=null?p.sk:cx*F.s+cy*F.c+(p.z0||p.z||0)*.6+(p.k==='flat'?-1e4:0),p])}
  for(const pp of(o.people||[]))items.push([pp.lx*F.s+pp.ly*F.c+(pp.z!=null?pp.z:fb)*.6+.5,{k:'person',pp}]);
  items.sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]);
  for(const[,p]of items)part(c,F,p,M,N,lod,o,spec);
   
   
  if(N>.2&&!o.noLights)lightsOf(c,F,M,N,o,spec,lod);
  if(spec.name&&lod>1&&L>200&&N<.6){const q=pj(F,h===0||Math.cos(h)>0?L*.36:-L*.36,B*.5,fb*.55);c.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.85)';c.font='600 '+(fb*.9).toFixed(1)+'px Segoe UI,Arial';c.textAlign='center';c.fillText(spec.name,q[0],q[1])}
  return F}catch(e){ERR.n++;ERR.e=ERR.e||String(e&&e.stack||e).slice(0,400);return null}}
 function part(c,F,p,M,N,lod,o,spec){const fb=M.fb,L=spec.L,B=spec.B,lv=M.lv;
  switch(p.k){
   case'box':drawBox(c,F,p,N,lod);break;
   case'cyl':drawCyl(c,F,p,N);break;
   case'hcyl':{ 
    const mm=L/M.ty.real[0],rx=p.r*mm,n=14,E=(t,y)=>pj(F,p.x+Math.cos(t)*rx,(p.y||0)+y,p.z+Math.sin(t)*p.r),A=[];for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const t=i/n*TAU;A.push(E(t,-p.w),E(t,p.w))}

    if(lod>1&&p.net){c.strokeStyle=shade(p.net,.7,N);c.lineWidth=.35;c.beginPath();for(const t of[.45,.8,1.25,1.7,2.15,2.6]){const a=E(t,-p.w*.96),b=E(t,p.w*.96);c.moveTo(a[0],a[1]);c.lineTo(b[0],b[1])}c.stroke()}
    const ye=F.c>0?p.w:-p.w,D=[];for(let i=0;i<n;i++)D.push(E(i/n*TAU,ye));c.fillStyle=shade(p.end||p.col,.95,N);c.beginPath();poly(c,D);c.fill();
    if(lod>0){const q=pj(F,p.x,(p.y||0)+ye,p.z);c.fillStyle=shade('#2a2f35',1,N);c.beginPath();c.arc(q[0],q[1],Math.max(.5,rx*.22),0,TAU);c.fill()}break}
   case'flat':{c.fillStyle=shade(p.col,1,N);c.beginPath();poly(c,p.pts.map(q=>pj(F,q[0],q[1],p.z)));c.fill();if(p.line&&lod>1){c.strokeStyle=p.line;c.lineWidth=.6;c.stroke()}break}
   case'mast':{if(lod===0&&p.w<1.2)break;const a=pj(F,p.x,p.y,p.z0),b=pj(F,p.x,p.y,p.z1);line(c,a,b,Math.max(.5,p.w*.8),shade(p.col,.9,N));

     else line(c,pj(F,p.x+Math.cos(an)*p.radar,p.y+Math.sin(an)*p.radar,z),pj(F,p.x-Math.cos(an)*p.radar,p.y-Math.sin(an)*p.radar,z),1.2,shade('#2a2f35',1,N))}

    if(p.boom&&lod>0)line(c,pj(F,p.x,p.y,p.z0+.2),pj(F,p.boom[0],p.boom[1],p.boom[2]),p.bw||.7,shade(p.col,.85,N));
    if(lod>1&&p.w<1.6)line(c,pj(F,p.x,p.y,p.z1),pj(F,p.x-L*.02,p.y,p.z1+.9),.35,'rgba(40,44,48,.8)');break}
   case'glass':{

   case'motor':{const ku=p.up?1.4:1;for(let i=0;i<p.n;i++){const y=(p.n>1?(i-(p.n-1)/2)*B*(p.up?.3:.32):0),x0=p.x-(p.big?.9:.6)*L/14*ku,x1=p.x+.05*L/14,w=B*(p.big?.11:.08)*(p.up?1.25:1);drawBox(c,F,{x0,x1,y0:y-w,y1:y+w,z0:.15,z1:M.fb+(p.big?.75:.5)*ku,col:p.col||'#2a2f35',top:p.top||'#3a4046',stripe:p.band,sf:p.up?[.5,.72]:null},N,lod);

   case'fender':{const out=M.out.P,n=out.length;c.strokeStyle=shade(p.col||'#26292c',1,N);c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,p.w*(L/270)*1.2);c.lineJoin='round';c.beginPath();let first=true;

   case'tyres':{if(lod<1)break;for(let i=0;i<p.n;i++){const x=-L*.36+i*L*.72/(p.n-1);for(const s of[-1,1]){if(s*F.c<-.08)continue;

   case'num':{if(lod<2)break;const q=pj(F,p.x,p.y,p.z);c.fillStyle='#1d1f22';c.font='700 '+(B*.22).toFixed(1)+'px Arial';c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='middle';c.fillText(p.txt,q[0],q[1]);c.textBaseline='alphabetic';break}

 function lightsOf(c,F,M,N,o,spec,lod){const Lt=M.lights,L=spec.L,B=spec.B,a=cl(N*1.2,0,1),r=Math.max(5,Math.min(24,L*.05+4)),under=o.under||(o.u||0)>3,refl=(o.anchor==='deck'?0:1);
  const P=v=>pj(F,v[0],v[1],v[2]),ry=v=>(v[2]-F.zr)*KZ*refl;
  if(under){if(Lt.side){const sY=Lt.side[1];lamp(c,...P([Lt.side[0],-sY,Lt.side[2]]),'red',r*.7,a,ry(Lt.side));lamp(c,...P([Lt.side[0],sY,Lt.side[2]]),'green',r*.7,a,ry(Lt.side))}
   if(Lt.mast)lamp(c,...P(Lt.mast),'white',r*.8,a,ry(Lt.mast));if(Lt.fwd)lamp(c,...P(Lt.fwd),'white',r*.7,a,ry(Lt.fwd));if(Lt.stern)lamp(c,...P(Lt.stern),'white',r*.6,a,ry(Lt.stern))}
  else{if(Lt.mast)lamp(c,...P(Lt.mast),'white',r*.5,a*.75,0);else if(Lt.stern)lamp(c,...P(Lt.stern),'white',r*.45,a*.7,0)}
  if(Lt.beacon==='blue'&&under&&(F.t*2.2%1)<.5)lamp(c,...P([Lt.mast[0],0,Lt.mast[2]-.6]),'blue',r,a,0);
  if(Lt.beacon==='pilot'&&Lt.mast){lamp(c,...P([Lt.mast[0],0,Lt.mast[2]-.5]),'white',r*.5,a*.9,0);lamp(c,...P([Lt.mast[0],0,Lt.mast[2]-1.1]),'red',r*.5,a*.9,0)}
  if((Lt.work&&o.fishing)||(L>200&&!under)){const q=Lt.stern?P([Lt.stern[0]+L*.08,0,Lt.stern[2]+1.2]):P([0,0,M.fb+3]);lamp(c,...q,'warm',r*1.6,a*.55,0)}
  if(L>400){for(let x=-L*.3;x<L*.35;x+=L*.16)lamp(c,...P([x,0,M.fb+6]),'warm',r*1.1,a*.35,0)}}
  
 

 const TRL=new Map(),WK=new Map();
 function trailRec(spec,F,o){const now=performance.now(),k=spec.id;let T=TRL.get(k);const sx=F.x-F.c*spec.L*.5,sy=F.y-F.s*spec.L*.5,u=o.u||0;
  if(!T||now-T.t>1000){T={P:[],t:now};TRL.set(k,T);if(TRL.size>80)TRL.delete(TRL.keys().next().value)}T.t=now;T.cur={x:sx,y:sy,L:spec.L,u};
  if(u>3&&(!T.P.length||now-T.P[T.P.length-1].t>=100)){T.P.push({x:sx,y:sy,h:F.h,u,t:now});}const maxAge=Math.min(6,3*spec.L/Math.max(u,1));while(T.P.length&&now-T.P[0].t>maxAge*1000)T.P.shift();if(T.P.length>80)T.P.shift()}
 function wake(c,F,spec,o,lod){const L=spec.L,B=spec.B,u=o.u||0,T=o.trail,k=cl(u/(L>200?30:45),.15,1)*(1-.55*(o.night!=null?o.night:nightNow())),fz=o.anchor==='deck'?F.zr*KZ:0;c.save();c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';
  const sideways=o.vx!=null&&Math.abs(-o.vx*F.s+o.vy*F.c)>Math.abs(o.vx*F.c+o.vy*F.s)*1.2;
  if(sideways){const vn=Math.hypot(o.vx,o.vy)||1,nx=-o.vx/vn,ny=-o.vy/vn;c.fillStyle='rgba(240,250,255,'+(.3*k).toFixed(2)+')';c.beginPath();
   const a=[F.x-F.c*L*.45+nx*B*.5,F.y-F.s*L*.45+ny*B*.5+fz],b=[F.x+F.c*L*.45+nx*B*.5,F.y+F.s*L*.45+ny*B*.5+fz];c.moveTo(a[0],a[1]);c.lineTo(b[0],b[1]);c.lineTo(b[0]+nx*B*.5,b[1]+ny*B*.5);c.lineTo(a[0]+nx*B*.5,a[1]+ny*B*.5);c.fill();c.restore();return}
  const now=performance.now(),maxAge=Math.min(6,3*L/Math.max(u,1)),stern={x:F.x-F.c*L*.5,y:F.y-F.s*L*.5,h:F.h,u,t:now},P=[stern];if(T)for(let i=T.length-1;i>=0;i--){const q=T[i],ag=(now-q.t)/1000;if(ag>maxAge)break;P.push(q)}
  if(P.length>1&&Math.hypot(P[1].x-P[0].x,P[1].y-P[0].y)>Math.max(14,u*.2))P.length=1;

   WK.set(spec.id||'?',{L,u:Math.round(u),len:Math.round(run),gap:Math.round(Math.hypot(P[1].x-P[0].x,P[1].y-P[0].y)),t:now});
   for(const side of[1,-1]){let prev=null;for(const q of P){const ag=(now-q.t)/1000,f=ag/maxAge,sp=B*.42+ag*(q.u||u)*.17,sx=-Math.sin(q.h)*side,sy=Math.cos(q.h)*side,pt=[q.x+sx*sp,q.y+sy*sp+fz];
     if(prev){c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+(.55*(1-f)*k).toFixed(3)+')';c.lineWidth=Math.max(.6,B*.04)+ag*.45;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(prev[0],prev[1]);c.lineTo(pt[0],pt[1]);c.stroke()}prev=pt}}
   for(const q of P){const ag=(now-q.t)/1000;if(ag>1.8)break;c.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+(.3*(1-ag/1.8)*k).toFixed(3)+')';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(q.x,q.y+fz,B*.3+ag*B*.12,B*.2+ag*B*.06,q.h,0,TAU);c.fill()}}

  c.restore()}
  
 function wakeAudit(){const now=performance.now(),rows=[];for(const [id,w] of WK){if(now-w.t>1500)continue;rows.push({id,L:Math.round(w.L),u:w.u,len:w.len,ratio:+(w.len/w.L).toFixed(2),firstGap:w.gap})}

 const VEL=new Map();
 function vel(id,x,y,now){let q=VEL.get(id);if(!q||now<q.t||now-q.t>1500){q={x,y,t:now,u:0,vx:0,vy:0};VEL.set(id,q);if(VEL.size>300)VEL.delete(VEL.keys().next().value);return q}
  const dt=(now-q.t)/1000;if(dt>=.04){const vx=(x-q.x)/dt,vy=(y-q.y)/dt;q.vx=lerp(q.vx,vx,.4);q.vy=lerp(q.vy,vy,.4);q.u=Math.hypot(q.vx,q.vy);q.x=x;q.y=y;q.t=now}return q}
  
 const SPR=new Map();
 function still(c,key,spec,x,y,h,t,o,dh,bob){const M=model(spec),z=zoomNow(),q=z<.3?.35:z<.6?.6:z<1.1?1:z<1.8?1.5:z<2.4?2:3,qq=spec.L>500?Math.min(q,1):q,N=o.night!=null?o.night:nightNow(),nb=N>.5?1:0,lod=z<.32?0:z<.8?1:2,
  k=key+'|'+qq+'|'+nb+'|'+lod;let S=SPR.get(k);
  if(!S){const L=spec.L,B=spec.B,ca=Math.abs(Math.cos(h)),sa=Math.abs(Math.sin(h)),ex=L/2*ca+B/2*sa+6,ey=L/2*sa+B/2*ca+6,zr=o.anchor==='deck'?M.fb:0,top=ey+(M.zTop-zr)*KZ+14,bot=ey+zr*KZ+M.fb*KZ+M.zTop*SY+14,lef=ex+10,rig=ex+M.zTop*SX+14;
   const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=Math.ceil((lef+rig)*qq);cv.height=Math.ceil((top+bot)*qq);const g=cv.getContext('2d');g.scale(qq,qq);
   paint(g,spec,lef,top,h,0,Object.assign({},o,{u:0,under:false,lod,night:nb?1:0,ph:0,wave:0}));S={cv,lef,top,w:lef+rig,h:top+bot};SPR.set(k,S);
   if(SPR.size>160){const k0=SPR.keys().next().value,o0=SPR.get(k0);SPR.delete(k0);try{o0.cv.width=0}catch(e){}}}
  if(dh){c.save();c.translate(x,y+(bob||0));c.rotate(dh);c.drawImage(S.cv,-S.lef,-S.top,S.w,S.h);c.restore()}else c.drawImage(S.cv,x-S.lef,y-S.top+(bob||0),S.w,S.h);
  if(N>.2&&nb===0)0;return S}

var WEATHER=(function(){
 const SEG=3,BLEND=1.5,KINDS=['clear','cloudy','rain','wind'],HE={clear:'בהיר',cloudy:'מעונן',rain:'גשום',wind:'סוער — רוח חזקה'},
  W={summer:{clear:.62,cloudy:.22,rain:.04,wind:.12},winter:{clear:.3,cloudy:.3,rain:.25,wind:.15}},
  WIND={clear:[4,10],cloudy:[7,14],rain:[12,22],wind:[20,32]},CLOUD={clear:.08,cloudy:.7,rain:.95,wind:.45},RAIN={clear:0,cloudy:0,rain:1,wind:.15};
 const ST={seed:20261108,override:null};
 const rnd=(a,b)=>{let h=Math.imul(ST.seed^Math.imul(a+1,2654435761),1597334677)^Math.imul(b+7,374761393);h=Math.imul(h^(h>>>15),2246822507);h=Math.imul(h^(h>>>13),3266489909);return((h^(h>>>16))>>>0)/4294967296};
 const season=()=>(+window.__TC_WINTER||0)>.5?'winter':'summer';
 function pick(i,sea){const w=W[sea],r=rnd(i,1);let acc=0;for(const k of KINDS){acc+=w[k];if(r<acc)return k}return'clear'}
 function slot(i,sea){const kind=ST.override||pick(i,sea),[a,b]=WIND[kind],wind=a+(b-a)*rnd(i,2),dir=rnd(Math.floor(i/4),3)*Math.PI*2+(rnd(i,4)-.5)*.8;return{kind,wind,dir,cloud:CLOUD[kind],rain:RAIN[kind]}}
  
 function atAbs(H,sea){sea=sea||season();const i=Math.floor(H/SEG),f=(H-i*SEG)/SEG,cur=slot(i,sea),prev=slot(i-1,sea),u=Math.min(1,f*SEG/BLEND),e=u*u*(3-2*u),mix=(a,b)=>a+(b-a)*e;
  let d=cur.dir-prev.dir;d=Math.atan2(Math.sin(d),Math.cos(d));
  return{kind:e<.5?prev.kind:cur.kind,next:cur.kind,from:prev.kind,t:+e.toFixed(3),wind:+mix(prev.wind,cur.wind).toFixed(1),dir:prev.dir+d*e,cloud:+mix(prev.cloud,cur.cloud).toFixed(2),rain:+mix(prev.rain,cur.rain).toFixed(2),season:sea,he:HE[e<.5?prev.kind:cur.kind],slot:i,seed:ST.seed}}
 function at(day,hour){return atAbs((Math.max(1,day|0)-1)*24+(+hour||0))}
 function now(){try{const g=gameClock();return at(g.day,g.hour+g.minute/60)}catch(e){return at(1,12)}}
 function audit(){const out=[];let bad=0,jump=0;for(let H=0;H<24*14;H+=.25){const a=atAbs(H),b=atAbs(H+.25);if(!KINDS.includes(a.kind))bad++;if(Math.abs(a.wind-b.wind)>6)jump++}
  const cnt={};for(let i=0;i<400;i++){const k=pick(i,'summer');cnt[k]=(cnt[k]||0)+1}return{ok:!bad&&!jump,bad,jump,summer:cnt,kinds:KINDS,seed:ST.seed}}
 return{at,atAbs,now,season,audit,KINDS,HE,state:ST,setSeed:s=>{ST.seed=s>>>0},force:k=>{ST.override=KINDS.includes(k)?k:null}}})();

function wldSkyAt(min,sea){const S=wldSun(sea),R=S.rise,T=S.set,m=((min%1440)+1440)%1440;let night=0,warm=0,phase='day';

function lbGRoute(a,b){const G=LBG,r=s=>Math.round(s*10)/10,key=(l,s)=>l+'|'+s,A=[a[0],r(a[1])],B=[b[0],r(b[1])];

 const dist=new Map([[key(A[0],A[1]),0]]),prev=new Map(),open=[[0,A[0],A[1]]],done=new Set(),goal=key(B[0],B[1]);
 while(open.length){let bi=0;for(let i=1;i<open.length;i++)if(open[i][0]<open[bi][0])bi=i;const [d,l,s]=open.splice(bi,1)[0],k=key(l,s);if(done.has(k))continue;done.add(k);if(k===goal)break;
  const relax=(l2,s2,c,how)=>{const k2=key(l2,s2),nd=d+c;if(nd<(dist.has(k2)?dist.get(k2):Infinity)){dist.set(k2,nd);prev.set(k2,[k,how]);open.push([nd,l2,s2])}};
  const S=st(l),i=S.indexOf(s);if(i>=0&&i+1<S.length)relax(l,S[i+1],S[i+1]-s,{lane:l,s0:s,s1:S[i+1]});
  for(const q of G.links)if(q.a[0]===l&&Math.abs(r(q.a[1])-s)<.06)relax(q.b[0],r(q.b[1]),q.len,{link:q})}
 if(!dist.has(goal))return null;const pieces=[];let k=goal;while(prev.has(k)){const [pk,how]=prev.get(k);pieces.unshift(how);k=pk}
 let pts=[];for(const h of pieces){if(h.link)pts=pts.concat(h.link.pts);else pts=pts.concat(lbGSlice(h.lane,h.s0,h.s1))}
 if(!pts.length){const p=termAt(G.lanes[A[0]],A[1]);pts=[[p.x,p.y]]}return{pts,len:dist.get(goal)}}

  const TEX = new Map(); let TEXB = 0;
  function tex(kind, o, ts) {
    const key = kind + '|' + o.col + '|' + (o.side || 0) + '|' + (o.night ? 1 : 0) + '|' + (kind === 'side' && o.side === 1 ? (+o.door || 0).toFixed(2) : '') + '|' + ts.toFixed(3);
    let e = TEX.get(key); if (e) { TEX.delete(key); TEX.set(key, e); return e }
    const w = kind === 'side' ? 1200 : 255, h = kind === 'side' ? 319 : 296, cv = mk(w * ts, h * ts), g = cv.getContext('2d');
    g.setTransform(cv.width / w, 0, 0, cv.height / h, 0, 0); g.lineJoin = 'round';
    (kind === 'side' ? sideTex : kind === 'front' ? frontTex : rearTex)(g, Object.assign({}, o, { ts }));
    e = { cv, w, h }; TEX.set(key, e); TEXB += cv.width * cv.height * 4;
    while (TEXB > BXP.texMB * 1048576 && TEX.size > 1) { const [k0, e0] = TEX.entries().next().value; TEX.delete(k0); TEXB -= e0.cv.width * e0.cv.height * 4 }
    return e }

  
  const UV = [0, 3, 8, 15, 25, 40, 85, 127.5, 170, 215, 230, 240, 247, 252, 255], VV = [0, 55, 130, 200, 260, 296];
  function expanded(tri) { const n = tri.length, E = tri.map((p, i) => { const q = tri[(i + 1) % n], nx = q[1] - p[1], ny = p[0] - q[0], len = Math.hypot(nx, ny); return [nx, ny, nx * p[0] + ny * p[1] + .8 * len] });
    return E.map((a, i) => { const b = E[(i + n - 1) % n], d = a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; return [(a[2] * b[1] - b[2] * a[1]) / d, (a[0] * b[2] - b[0] * a[2]) / d] }) }
  
  function affine(tri, Pw, point) { const [a, b, c] = tri, [u0, v0] = a, [u1, v1] = b, [u2, v2] = c, [x0, y0] = Pw(...point(u0, v0)), [x1, y1] = Pw(...point(u1, v1)), [x2, y2] = Pw(...point(u2, v2)), d = (u1 - u0) * (v2 - v0) - (u2 - u0) * (v1 - v0);
    const A = ((x1 - x0) * (v2 - v0) - (x2 - x0) * (v1 - v0)) / d, B = ((y1 - y0) * (v2 - v0) - (y2 - y0) * (v1 - v0)) / d, C = ((u1 - u0) * (x2 - x0) - (u2 - u0) * (x1 - x0)) / d, D = ((u1 - u0) * (y2 - y0) - (u2 - u0) * (y1 - y0)) / d;
    return [A, B, C, D, x0 - A * u0 - C * v0, y0 - B * u0 - D * v0] }
  function shellPanels(front, cs, sn, Pw, queue, texE, sunOv) {
    const point = front ? nosePoint : tailPoint;
    for (let i = 0; i < UV.length - 1; i++) for (let j = 0; j < VV.length - 1; j++) {
      const u0 = UV[i], u1 = UV[i + 1], v0 = VV[j], v1 = VV[j + 1], a = point(u0, (v0 + v1) / 2), b = point(u1, (v0 + v1) / 2), dxdy = (b[0] - a[0]) / (b[1] - a[1]);
      let visv; if (front) { const rake = 4.8 * ((a[2] + b[2]) / 2) / H ** 2; visv = K * (sn - dxdy * cs) + rake } else { const y = (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, z = (a[2] + b[2]) / 2, rake = (tailX(y, z + .01) - tailX(y, z - .01)) / .02; visv = K * (-sn + dxdy * cs) + rake }
      if (visv < .0001) continue;
      const panels = j === 0 && (i < 3 || i > 10) ? [[[u0, v0], [u1, v0], [u1, v1]], [[u0, v0], [u1, v1], [u0, v1]]] : [[[u0, v0], [u1, v0], [u1, v1], [u0, v1]]];
      for (const tri of panels) {
        const world = tri.map(p => point(...p)), depth = world.reduce((s, p) => s + K * (p[0] * sn + p[1] * cs) + p[2], 0) / tri.length, ym = (world[0][1] + world[1][1]) / 2;
        
        const e1 = [world[1][0] - world[0][0], world[1][1] - world[0][1], world[1][2] - world[0][2]], e2 = [world[2][0] - world[0][0], world[2][1] - world[0][1], world[2][2] - world[0][2]];
        let n = [e1[1] * e2[2] - e1[2] * e2[1], e1[2] * e2[0] - e1[0] * e2[2], e1[0] * e2[1] - e1[1] * e2[0]]; const nl = Math.hypot(...n) || 1; n = n.map(q => q / nl); if ((front ? 1 : -1) * n[0] < 0) n = n.map(q => -q);
        const shade = .04 + .16 * Math.abs(ym) / HW, M = affine(tri, Pw, point), clip = expanded(tri), ov = sunOv([n[0] * cs - n[1] * sn, n[0] * sn + n[1] * cs, n[2]]);
        queue(depth, g => { g.save(); g.transform(...M); g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(clip[0][0], clip[0][1]); for (let q = 1; q < clip.length; q++) g.lineTo(clip[q][0], clip[q][1]); g.closePath(); g.clip();
          g.drawImage(texE.cv, 0, 0, texE.cv.width, texE.cv.height, 0, 0, 255, 296); g.globalAlpha = shade; g.fillStyle = '#082534'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 255, 296);
          if (ov) { g.globalAlpha = ov[1]; g.fillStyle = ov[0]; g.fillRect(0, 0, 255, 296) } g.restore() }) } } }

  
  function sprite(o) {
    const N = o.N || 32, k = ((o.k % N) + N) % N, th = k / N * Math.PI * 2, cs = Math.cos(th), sn = Math.sin(th), res = o.res || 1, col = o.col || '#ee7d2d', night = !!o.night, door = clamp(+o.door || 0, 0, 1);
    const wx = (x, y) => x * cs - y * sn, wy = (x, y, z) => x * sn + y * cs - K * z;
    let x0b = 1e9, x1b = -1e9, y0b = 1e9, y1b = -1e9; const grow = (x, y) => { if (x < x0b) x0b = x; if (x > x1b) x1b = x; if (y < y0b) y0b = y; if (y > y1b) y1b = y };
    for (const x of [-60.5, 60.5]) for (const y of [-12.9, 12.9]) for (const z of [0, TOP + .3]) { grow(wx(x, y), wy(x, y, z)); grow(wx(x, y) + SUN.x * z, x * sn + y * cs + SUN.y * z) }

  function polyW(g, Pw, pts, fill, stroke, sw) { g.beginPath(); pts.forEach((p, i) => { const q = Pw(...p); if (i) g.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); else g.moveTo(q[0], q[1]) }); g.closePath(); if (fill) { g.fillStyle = fill; g.fill() } if (stroke) { g.strokeStyle = stroke; g.lineWidth = sw; g.stroke() } }
  function hull(pts) { const P = pts.slice().sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]), cr = (o, a, b) => (a[0] - o[0]) * (b[1] - o[1]) - (a[1] - o[1]) * (b[0] - o[0]), lo = [], up = [];
    for (const p of P) { while (lo.length >= 2 && cr(lo[lo.length - 2], lo[lo.length - 1], p) <= 0) lo.pop(); lo.push(p) } for (let i = P.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = P[i]; while (up.length >= 2 && cr(up[up.length - 2], up[up.length - 1], p) <= 0) up.pop(); up.push(p) }
    up.pop(); lo.pop(); return lo.concat(up) }

  function serialStk(kind, s, ts) {

  function stickers(ctx, k, N, o) {
    const F = faces(k, N), px = o.px || 1, ts = Math.min(.6, Math.max(.12, (o.res || 1) * .16)), night = !!o.night; let n = 0;
    const put = (M, e, x, y, mir) => { ctx.save(); ctx.transform(M[0], M[1], M[2], M[3], M[4], M[5]); if (mir) ctx.transform(-1, 0, 0, 1, 2 * x + e.w, 0); ctx.drawImage(e.cv, x - e.m, y - e.m, e.w + 2 * e.m, e.h + 2 * e.m); ctx.restore(); n++ };

      if (F.rear) { const e = serialStk('rear', o.serial, ts * 1.6); put(F.rear.Ms, e, 127 - e.w / 2, 254 - e.h * .8) } }
    return n }
  const info = { length: L, width: W, height: H, top: TOP, K, wheels: [{ u: -39.6, r: 5.1, hw: 12.65 }, { u: 36, r: 5.1, hw: 12.65 }],

  const s0=statsOf(m,up0),s1=statsOf(m,up1);let stat;
  if(cat==='engine')stat='מנוע '+val+': מהירות '+s0.kn+' ← '+s1.kn+' קשר · תאוצה +'+Math.round((s1.acc/s0.acc-1)*100)+'%';
  else if(cat==='tank')stat='מיכל דלק '+val+': '+s0.tank+' ← '+s1.tank+' ליטר · טווח +'+Math.round((s1.tank/s0.tank-1)*100)+'%';
  else if(cat==='fishing')stat='ציוד דיג '+val+': '+s0.rods+' ← '+s1.rods+' חכות'+(val>2?' · גם לדגים הגדולים':val>1?' · דיג בשיט (טרולינג)':' · דיג בים העמוק');
  else if(cat==='elec')stat=val>1?'אלקטרוניקה 2: מכ״ם — הכיוון והמרחק לנקודת הדיג ולמעגן, גם בלילה':'אלקטרוניקה 1: מאתר דגים — נשיכות מהירות ב-15%, והלהקה בשורת הסירה';
  else stat='צבע ועיצוב: גוף '+HNAME(lv0[0])+' ← '+HNAME(lv1[0])+' · פס '+HNAME(lv0[1])+' ← '+HNAME(lv1[1])+' · צבע תחתית: מהירות '+s0.kn+' ← '+s1.kn+' קשר';
  const vis=visTxt(m,cat,val,up0,lv1);return{stat,vis,line:stat+' · נוסף: '+vis,up0,up1,lv0,lv1,s0,s1}}

  
 function P(){const w=PlayerProfile.worldPersistent||(PlayerProfile.worldPersistent={});const s=w.boatshop||(w.boatshop={v:1,boats:[],seq:0,job:null,stats:{bought:0,sails:0,upgrades:0,sold:0}});if(!Array.isArray(s.boats))s.boats=[];if(!s.stats)s.stats={bought:0,sails:0,upgrades:0,sold:0};return s}
 const OWN=[];

 function freeSlot(cls){const used=new Set(P().boats.filter(r=>r.st!=='out').map(r=>r.slot)),i0=CLS.indexOf(cls);for(let i=i0;i<CLS.length;i++){if(i>i0&&cls==='jet')break;const s=SL.find(q=>q.cls===CLS[i]&&!used.has(q.n));if(s)return s}return null}
 function beOf(s,L){const cx=s.x+s.w/2,cy=QY+6+L/2;return{i:-1,n:'שלך · מקום '+s.n,slot:s.n,pier:'MY',cx,cy,h:-Math.PI/2,board:[s.x-G.fw/2,Math.min(s.fin[3]-5,QY+8+L*.45)],rect:[s.x,QY,s.x+s.w,QY+s.d],lane:LY}}
 const dockY=b=>G.dock[1]+12+b.L/2;
  
 const southRev=b=>Math.abs(ang(Math.PI/2-(b.h!=null?b.h:-Math.PI/2)))>Math.PI/2;
 function rOut(b,to){const be=b.be,L=[F.go(be.cx,LY,22,{rev:southRev(b),tol:3})];if(to)L.push(F.pivot(Math.atan2(to[1]-LY,to[0]-be.cx)),F.go(to[0],to[1],b.maxV*.65,{tol:16}));return L}
 function toLane(b,L){    
  const v=b.maxV*.6;
  if(F.inBasin(b.x,b.y)){const GP=F.GAP,ly=b.y<2010?GP.LANES[0]:b.y<2350?GP.LANES[1]:GP.LANES[2];if(Math.abs(b.y-ly)>6&&b.x<6960)L.push(F.go(b.x,ly,9,{tol:4}));L.push(F.go(GP.FAIR_X,ly,20),F.go(GP.FAIR_S[0],GP.FAIR_S[1],20),F.go(GP.IN[0],GP.IN[1],22),F.go(GP.OUT[0],GP.OUT[1],30,{tol:10}),F.go(G.stage[0],G.stage[1],v,{tol:16}));return[G.stage[0],G.stage[1]]}
  if(b.y<LY-4){if(b.x<7215){L.push(F.go(G.stage[0],G.stage[1],v,{tol:16}));return[G.stage[0],G.stage[1]]}L.push(F.go(b.x,LY,22,{rev:southRev(b),tol:4}));return[b.x,LY]}
  return[b.x,b.y]}
 function rHome(b){const be=b.be,L=[],v=b.maxV*.6;let[px,py]=toLane(b,L);
  if(py>LY+4&&!F.seaLine(px,py,be.cx,LY)){const q=[Math.max(px,7120),Math.max(py,LY+40)];L.push(F.go(q[0],q[1],v,{tol:20}));px=q[0];py=q[1]}
  if(Math.hypot(px-be.cx,py-LY)>8){if(Math.abs(py-LY)<6)L.push(F.pivot(be.cx<px?Math.PI:0));L.push(F.go(be.cx,LY,Math.min(v,70),{tol:5}))}
  L.push(F.pivot(-Math.PI/2),F.go(be.cx,be.cy,9,{tol:2,end:true}),F.pivot(be.h));return L}
 function rYard(b){const L=[];let[px,py]=toLane(b,L);if(py>LY+4){L.push(F.go(px,LY,b.maxV*.5,{tol:6}));py=LY}
  L.push(F.pivot(DKX<px?Math.PI:0),F.go(DKX,LY,40,{tol:4}),F.pivot(-Math.PI/2),F.go(DKX,dockY(b),8,{tol:2,end:true}),F.pivot(-Math.PI/2));return L}
 function rAway(b){const L=[];let[px,py]=toLane(b,L);L.push(F.pivot(Math.atan2(G.edge[1]-py,G.edge[0]-px)),F.go(G.edge[0],G.edge[1],b.maxV*.8,{tol:30}));return L}

 function nearMouth(b){if(!b.owned||!b.be||b.be.pier!=='MY')return null;const s=slotOf(b.be.slot);if(!s)return null;const mouth=QY+s.d,ax=Math.abs(ang(b.h+Math.PI/2)),bowS=ax>Math.PI/2,off=bowS?Math.PI-ax:ax;
  if(b.x<s.x-4||b.x>s.x+s.w+4||b.y<mouth+6||b.y>mouth+b.L*.6+40)return null;return{s,mouth,bowS,off,ok:off<=Math.PI*35/180&&Math.abs(b.u)<=14}}
 function hDock(b){const q=nearMouth(b);if(!q)return false;if(!q.ok){toast(Math.abs(b.u)>14?'מאטים לפני הקשירה':'מיישרים את הסירה מול המקום '+b.be.slot+' — ואז E');return true}
  const be=b.be,h=q.bowS?Math.PI/2:-Math.PI/2,ey=q.mouth+b.L/2+2,L=[];if(b.y>ey+4)L.push(F.go(be.cx,ey,16,{rev:q.bowS,tol:3}));
  L.push(F.go(be.cx,be.cy,11,{rev:q.bowS,tol:2,end:true}),{k:'settle',x:be.cx,y:be.cy,h,T:.9});b.mode='moor';b.moorH=h;b.legs=L;F.S.mooring=true;
  toast('איש המעגן זורק לך חבל ומושך את "'+b.name+'" למקום '+be.slot+'…');try{SaveManager.log('boatshop','dock_assist',{boat:b.id,slot:be.slot})}catch(e){}return true}

  
 function refresh(b){const r=b.rec,m=b.model,u=r.up,T=BOAT34.T[m.t34],eg=UP.engine,anti=u.anti?1.03:1;
  b.name=r.name;b.maxV=m.kn*5.144*eg.vK[u.engine||0]*anti;b.acc=m.acc*eg.aK[u.engine||0];b.turn=m.turn;b.speed=Math.round(b.maxV/5.144);b.tankMax=Math.round(m.tank*UP.tank.tK[u.tank||0]);b.burn=m.burn*eg.bK[u.engine||0];
  if(!(r.fuel>=0))r.fuel=b.tankMax;r.fuel=Math.min(r.fuel,b.tankMax);
  const g=FGEAR[cl(u.fishing||0,0,3)];b.rods=g.rods;b.tools=g.tools;b.weights=g.weights;b.biteK=(u.elec||0)>=1?.85:1;
  const base=T.lv[0];b.lv=Object.assign({},base,{hull:r.lv[0],stripe:r.lv[1],boot:parseInt(r.lv[0].slice(1,3),16)>150?r.lv[1]:'#2a2f35',funnel:r.lv[1]});if(m.t34==='jetski')b.lv.sup='#1d1f22';
  b.hull=r.lv[0];b.stripe=r.lv[1];b.rim=r.lv[1];b.top=base.sup;b.deck=base.deck;
  b.upKey=[u.engine||0,u.tank||0,u.fishing||0,u.elec||0,u.design||0].join('');b.__spec=null;return b}
 function mk(r){const m=MOD[r.model],s=slotOf(r.slot);if(!m||!s)return null;const T=BOAT34.T[m.t34];if(!r.up)r.up={};if(!Array.isArray(r.lv))r.lv=m.liv[0].slice();

 function specOf(b){return b.__spec||(b.__spec={type:b.t34,L:b.L,B:b.B,id:b.id,variant:b.model.variant,lv:b.lv,lvKey:b.rec.lv.join('')+b.name,name:b.name,up:Object.assign({},b.rec.up),upKey:b.upKey})}
 function sync(){const B=F.BOATS;for(let i=B.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(B[i].owned)B.splice(i,1);OWN.length=0;for(const r of P().boats){const b=mk(r);if(b){B.push(b);OWN.push(b)}}}

   if(r.st==='in'){b.mode='yard';if(!(sv&&Number.isFinite(sv.x))){b.x=G.edge[0];b.y=G.edge[1];b.h=Math.PI}b.legs=rHome(b);b.onArrive=arrived}

 function sea(g,W,H,t){const gr=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);gr.addColorStop(0,'#3a8fc2');gr.addColorStop(1,'#1c6593');g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.13)';g.lineWidth=1.2;for(let y=14;y<H;y+=18){g.beginPath();for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=14)g.lineTo(x,y+Math.sin(x*.045+y+t*1.2)*2);g.stroke()}}
 function drawSpec(cv,sp,hd,t,zr){const g=cv.getContext('2d'),W=cv.width,H=cv.height,T=BOAT34.T[sp.type];g.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);sea(g,W,H,t);const sc=Math.min(W*.7,H*1.05)/(sp.L*.82+sp.B*.5+T.real[2]*(sp.L/(T.real[0]*10))*KZ*.5)*(zr||1);
  g.save();g.translate(W/2,H*.6);g.scale(sc,sc);try{BOAT34.paint(g,sp,0,0,hd,t,{night:0,u:0,lod:2,scaleHint:sc,wave:.25,thumb:false,noRefl:false,ph:0})}catch(e){er('cv',e)}g.restore()}
 function paintCv(){try{const body=$('phoneBody');if(!body||!State.phoneOpen||!POIS[State.interactionId])return;const t=performance.now()/1000;
   body.querySelectorAll('canvas[data-bs-cv]').forEach(cv=>{const [k,id,x]=cv.dataset.bsCv.split('|');
    if(k==='model'){const m=B.MOD[id],q=m.liv[+x||0],base=BOAT34.T[m.t34].lv[0],sp={type:m.t34,L:m.L,B:m.B,id:'SHOP-'+id,variant:m.variant,lvKey:'s'+x,lv:Object.assign({},base,{hull:q[0],stripe:q[1],boot:parseInt(q[0].slice(1,3),16)>150?q[1]:'#2a2f35',funnel:q[1]},m.t34==='jetski'?{sup:'#1d1f22'}:{}),up:{fishing:m.fish0||0},upKey:'f'+(m.fish0||0)};drawSpec(cv,sp,-.4+Math.floor(t/2.2)%8*Math.PI/4,t)}
    else{const b=B.byId(id);if(!b)return;let sp=B.specOf(b);if(k==='yard'&&(UI.pre||UI.paint)){const up=Object.assign({},b.rec.up),pt=UI.paint||{};if(UI.pre)up[UI.pre.cat]=UI.pre.l;if(pt.design!=null)up.design=pt.design;const hull=pt.hull||b.rec.lv[0],stripe=pt.stripe||b.rec.lv[1];
      sp=Object.assign({},sp,{id:'PRE-'+b.id,up,upKey:'p'+[up.engine||0,up.tank||0,up.fishing||0,up.elec||0,up.design||0].join(''),lvKey:hull+stripe,lv:Object.assign({},sp.lv,{hull,stripe,boot:parseInt(hull.slice(1,3),16)>150?stripe:'#2a2f35',funnel:stripe})})}
     drawSpec(cv,sp,k==='yard'?(-.45+Math.sin(t*.35)*.7):-.5,t,k==='yard'?.8:1)}})}catch(e){er('paintCv',e)}}
 setInterval(()=>{try{if(State.phoneOpen&&POIS[State.interactionId])paintCv()}catch(e){}},260);
 function act(a,id,x,y){B.live();const done=()=>{try{renderPhone()}catch(e){}};
  if(a==='tab'){UI.tab=id;return done()}if(a==='liv'){UI.liv[id]=+x;return done()}if(a==='buy'){B.buy(id,+x);return done()}
  if(a==='nav'){try{setNavigationTarget(id,{silent:true});toast('הניווט — אל '+(navPoiRegistry()[id]||{}).label)}catch(e){}return done()}
  if(a==='go'){try{setNavigationTarget('F3-BOARD-'+id,{silent:true});toast('הניווט — אל "'+B.byId(id).name+'"')}catch(e){}return done()}
  if(a==='fuel'){B.refuel(id);return done()}if(a==='sell'){B.sell(id);return done()}
  if(a==='name'){const el=document.querySelector('[data-bs-name="'+id+'"]');B.rename(id,el?el.value:'');try{wtcInvalidate()}catch(e){}return done()}
  if(a==='yard'){UI.yb=id;UI.pre=null;UI.paint=null;try{setNavigationTarget('G4-SHIPYARD',{silent:true})}catch(e){}toast('הניווט — אל המספנה. שם בוחרים את השדרוג');return done()}
  if(a==='yb'){UI.yb=id;UI.pre=null;UI.paint=null;return done()}if(a==='pre'){UI.pre=null;UI.paint=null;return done()}
  if(a==='see'){UI.pre={cat:id,l:+x,he:B.UP[id].he+' — דרגה '+x};return done()}
